newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai soybean ends mixed in slow trading.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai soybean ends mixed in slow trading.

text.p: Shanghai soybean futures ended mixed on Thursday in slow trading, with most investors staying on the sidelines, traders said.
The key January 1997 contract ended at 3,202 yuan ($386) per tonne, losing eight yuan. It opened at an intra-day low of 3,196 and hit a high of 3,239.
March fell 18 to 3,232 and May one to 3,297, July rose 18 to 3,380 and September three to 3,382 and November was unchanged at 3,400. Combined volume rose to 14,500 tonnes from 12,000.
Traders said Shanghai's active stock market attracted interest of many retail investors away from soybeans.
